package zztrust

import "github.com/polarisagi/polaris/internal/security/policy"

type mockPolicyHolder struct {
	Profile policy.TrustProfile
}

func selftestTrustProfileSwitch(h mockPolicyHolder) int {
	// 负向用例：对 .Profile 字段做 switch 分支（R3-08 门控盲区形态）
	switch h.Profile {
	case policy.ProfileHardened:
		return 1
	default:
		return 0
	}
}
